scripts.dev: concurrently -n frontend,backend -c blue,green "npm run dev -w frontend" "npm run dev -w backend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w frontend && npm run build -w backend
scripts.test: npm run test -w frontend && npm run test -w backend
scripts.type-check: npm run type-check -w frontend && npm run type-check -w backend
scripts.electron:dev: concurrently "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend" "wait-on http://localhost:3000 && tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json && NODE_ENV=development electron electron/dist/main.js"
scripts.electron:build: ELECTRON=true npm run build && npm run electron:prebuild && npx electron-rebuild -f -w better-sqlite3 --module-dir backend && tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json && electron-builder
